owner_note.text: Figma MCP tool-call limit reached for the Full seat (Professional plan). The preview rollout stopped after Templates; 1920 Desktop, 2600 XL, 3440 Mega, 1600 LG, 600 SM, 360 XS, Showcase and the Index remain. It resumes once the limit resets or the seat or plan is upgraded (a few minutes of your time). Details: /framework/ext/Figma/doc/preview-recipe.md
